_comment: Spoken layout commands (SpokenLayout), shared by the macOS and Windows tests. cases: apply(input); output null = the transcript comes back exactly as it was. Cases with a "limitation" are known false positives, pinned so a change to them is deliberate: a command word said as its own clause in a list or as an answer becomes a break (one visible, undoable line break; the toggle turns it off). edges: the line breaks at the very start and end kept out of the clean-up. layouts: layout(input, enabled), what a dictation uses.
